eyebrow.zh: 将标题、正文和引用转换成配音、字幕与卡片画面，输出 MP4、封面和 SRT。
eyebrow.en: Convert headings, narration and quotes into audio, subtitles and scene cards, producing MP4, cover and SRT files.

headline.zh: 从 Markdown 脚本生成横屏视频初稿。
headline.en: Turn a Markdown script into a video draft.

sub.zh: 将标题、正文和引用转换成配音、字幕与卡片画面，输出 MP4、封面和 SRT。
sub.en: Convert headings, narration and quotes into audio, subtitles and scene cards, producing MP4, cover and SRT files.

caption.zh: 图示展示组件关系；实际输出见下方示例。
caption.en: An illustrative component scene; recorded output appears below.

body.zh: Markdown 结构映射到片段与卡片。
body.en: Markdown structure maps to segments and cards.

body.zh: MP4、PNG 与 SRT 可以继续编辑。
body.en: MP4, PNG and SRT can be edited further.

body.zh: 静音 stub 可检查格式与渲染。
body.en: The silent stub exercises layout and rendering.

body.zh: 为讲解稿制作初稿时，标题卡、引用卡和字幕重复排版会占用不少时间。ZhiCast 约定一小套 Markdown 结构，把脚本解析、音频时序、字幕与画面串起来。作者仍负责检查内容、发音、节奏和发布后的实际呈现。
body.en: Video drafts repeat the work of arranging title cards, quote cards and subtitles. ZhiCast uses a small Markdown convention to connect parsing, audio timing, subtitles and frames. Authors remain responsible for checking content, pronunciation, pacing and the actual published presentation.

body.zh: 示例跑完整解析、静音音频、字幕、Pillow 场景与 ffmpeg 编码，并通过 ffprobe 读取视频尺寸和帧率。没有真实配音、上传或平台验收；临时成片在检查后清理。
body.en: The example runs parsing, silent audio, subtitles, Pillow scenes and ffmpeg encoding, then reads video dimensions and frame rate with ffprobe. It uses no real speech, upload or platform validation; temporary media is removed after inspection.

alt.zh: 示例跑完整解析、静音音频、字幕、Pillow 场景与 ffmpeg 编码，并通过 ffprobe 读取视频尺寸和帧率。没有真实配音、上传或平台验收；临时成片在检查后清理。
alt.en: The example runs parsing, silent audio, subtitles, Pillow scenes and ffmpeg encoding, then reads video dimensions and frame rate with ffprobe. It uses no real speech, upload or platform validation; temporary media is removed after inspection.

body.zh: parse 构建 ZhiScript，tts 填写片段时间与音频，subtitle 生成 SRT cue，overlay 用 Pillow 画卡片、字幕与封面，render 调用 ffmpeg 合成视频。CLI 与本地 Web 使用同一条处理路径，字幕绘制进 PNG 场景后编码，无需 libass。
body.en: parse builds ZhiScript; tts fills segment timing and audio; subtitle creates SRT cues; overlay draws cards, subtitles and covers with Pillow; render calls ffmpeg to compose video. CLI and local Web share this pipeline. Subtitles are drawn into PNG scenes before encoding, without libass.

alt.en: parse builds ZhiScript; tts fills segment timing and audio; subtitle creates SRT cues; overlay draws cards, subtitles and covers with Pillow; render calls ffmpeg to compose video. CLI and local Web share this pipeline. Subtitles are drawn into PNG scenes before encoding, without libass.

body.zh: 本地 CLI 可生成输出目录，Web 可粘贴脚本并下载结果。edge 是已实现的网络 TTS 路径；stub 生成静音。doubao 和 qwen 虽可通过参数选择，当前会明确报未实现。
body.en: The local CLI generates an output directory; the Web UI accepts pasted scripts and offers downloads. edge is an implemented network TTS path and stub generates silence. doubao and qwen are selectable names but currently raise not-implemented errors.

body.en: The local CLI generates an output directory; the Web UI accepts pasted scripts and offers downloads. edge is an implemented network TTS path and stub generates silence. doubao and qwen are selectable names but currently raise not-implemented errors.

body.zh: 默认 edge 音色为 zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural；--out 控制目录。RenderSpec 默认 1920×1080、30fps、CRF 23、libx264、yuv420p 与 AAC。字幕策略使用 28 个显示宽度单位/行、最多两行；它是项目排版约定，不是平台认证。edge 缺少词级时序时会在句级窗口内均匀分配，时序需人工回看。
body.en: The default edge voice is zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural and --out selects the directory. RenderSpec defaults to 1920×1080, 30fps, CRF 23, libx264, yuv420p and AAC. Subtitle policy uses 28 display-width units per line and up to two lines; this is a project layout convention, not platform certification. If word timing is unavailable, edge timing is distributed across sentence windows and needs review.

note.zh: 示例跑完整解析、静音音频、字幕、Pillow 场景与 ffmpeg 编码，并通过 ffprobe 读取视频尺寸和帧率。没有真实配音、上传或平台验收；临时成片在检查后清理。
note.en: The example runs parsing, silent audio, subtitles, Pillow scenes and ffmpeg encoding, then reads video dimensions and frame rate with ffprobe. It uses no real speech, upload or platform validation; temporary media is removed after inspection.

body.zh: 得到 3 段、3 条字幕、6 张场景图以及 1920×1080、30fps 的 H.264 视频。
body.en: Produces 3 segments, 3 subtitle cues, 6 scene images and a 1920×1080, 30fps H.264 video.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+、uv、ffmpeg/ffprobe、可用的 libx264/AAC 编码器和中文字体。macOS 可运行 brew install ffmpeg；Debian/Ubuntu 可安装 ffmpeg 与 fonts-noto-cjk。Web 表单当前还需单独安装 python-multipart，如下。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+, uv, ffmpeg/ffprobe, libx264/AAC encoders and a CJK font. On macOS use brew install ffmpeg; on Debian/Ubuntu install ffmpeg and fonts-noto-cjk. Web forms currently also require the separate python-multipart install shown below.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/zhicast.git
cd zhicast
uv venv --python 3.12
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
# Local Web form support:
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python python-multipart

limitations.zh: stub 输出静音并使用合成时间戳，不能据此评价真实配音或字幕对齐质量。
limitations.en: stub produces silence and synthetic timestamps; it cannot establish real speech or subtitle-alignment quality.

limitations.zh: 长句、字体覆盖和字幕分组需人工检查；没有执行 B站上传或推荐效果验证。
limitations.en: Review long sentences, font coverage and subtitle grouping manually. No Bilibili upload or distribution-effect validation was performed.
